narr: A shield of moderate to heavy rainfall, associated with the remnants of tropical cyclone Ida, moved from the DelMarVa peninsula to New England. This rainfall on top of several weeks of abnormally wet weather led to areas of small stream and urban flash flooding in Central New York.
ev: Flooding was occurring over Route 52A near the Stone Arch Bridge historical site.
Flash flooding was occurring on Holmes Road near the intersection with Greentree Road just to the east of NY-17.
Water was gushing across Whittaker Road near the intersection with Levine Road.
A swiftwater rescue was needed for a man stuck on the roof of his submerged car on Big Woods Road near the Harris Road intersection and the confluence of Spring Brook and the East Mongaup river.
